Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); flat=sum(grid,[])
    bg=Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    zeros=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==0]
    top,bottom=min(r for r,c in zeros),max(r for r,c in zeros)
    left,right=min(c for r,c in zeros),max(c for r,c in zeros)
    out=[row[left:right+1] for row in grid[top:bottom+1]]
    seen=set(); counts={}; sizes={}
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if (r,c) in seen or color in (0,bg) or (top<=r<=bottom and left<=c<=right): continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy in (-1,0,1):
            for dx in (-1,0,1):

              if (dy or dx) and 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:

        counts[color]=counts.get(color,0)+1
